newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.025pts to 103.030.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.025pts to 103.030.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds gained 0.025 points in Tuesday's trading to 103.030, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio rose 0.401 points to 2.473 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, gained 0.050 points to 99.410, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio rose 0.324 points to 2.502 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 1.089 points to 1,043.474.
